answer: A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vine counter is kept in delta and bridge reveals each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 555 identities would post 2289 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
